en.title: AI Music Weekly W.A 052
en.summary: This week's AI Music Weekly rounds up recent copyright rules, business shifts and product updates. Korea's Music Copyright Association is exploring a rights-ownership trust for AI music, Spotify plans to launch a compliant AI cover tool, and MiniMax is scaling back its domestic music cloud business. New releases include Suno MCP, a new ElevenLabs sound-effects model and an NI synthesizer. There are also six cutting-edge papers covering audio synthesis, music-score modeling and more — a quick way for music creators and audio developers to catch up on industry trends and practical tools.

items_all.title: DeepSeek这次，想把你从AI的监工岗位上解放出来
items_all.summary: 老金这篇文章把 Super-agent 的机制讲得很直白：Router 像调度员，记住任务关系并分派；Worker 在各自会话里并行执行，耗时操作转后台，独立检查者盯进度和跑偏。它用更多计算换更短、更稳的等待，但公开原型仍偏实验，需配 Harness、独立账号和隔离环境，主动任务先观察、代码先人工合并。

en.title: This time, DeepSeek wants to free you from the job of supervising AI
en.summary: Lao Jin’s article lays out the Super-agent mechanism plainly: the Router acts as a dispatcher, remembering task relationships and assigning work; Workers execute in parallel in their own sessions, time-consuming operations get moved to the background, and independent checkers monitor progress and drift. It trades more compute for shorter, steadier waits, but the public prototype is still experimental and requires a Harness, separate accounts, and isolated environments. Proactive tasks should be observed first, and code should be merged manually first.

en.title:
The "intelligent agent" dream from 25 years ago is coming true today — just in a different way

On November 2, MIT Technology Review published a long feature, The Agent Web Has Arrived (https://t.co/rVUmupywZn): today's AI assistants can sort email, compare prices, book restaurant tables and flights, and some are even authorized to access inboxes; websites are also starting to serve content to both humans and AI agents.
